verdict.rationale: There is no documented bulk export or account-exit feature. The REST API lets third parties 'access or manipulate configuration data' on an account, and the official MCP server can 'fetch' account information, so a user could script their own extraction. The CSV feature in the evidence is an import (users in), not an export. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export, explicit open-format export files (e.g. CSV/JSON dumps of incidents, schedules and analytics), coverage of all data types including incident history and post-incident reviews, offboarding/data-portability documentation, and independent corroboration that a complete exit is achievable.
